title: Server rendering
summary: Render a request-scoped router, serialize its snapshot, then hydrate with the browser route table.

sections.title: Load on the server
sections.body: Create a router per request. Passing a Request forwards headers and cancellation. Avoid sharing router state or user data between requests.

sections.title: Hydrate
sections.body: deserialize restores Error objects. A successful hydration snapshot avoids a duplicate initial loader request. Client-only routes render their fallback on the server and load in the browser.

sections.title: Production transport
sections.body: The browser proxy uses the configured dataEndpoint, defaulting to /_smolter, with a local route URL parameter. Match that endpoint in Vite and createRequestHandler. Use distinct app-scoped paths when several applications share one origin.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: GitHub Pages serves the browser examples and documentation. It cannot run server loaders. Run apps/react-ssr or apps/preact-ssr on a Node server to try request-time rendering and server mutations.

sections.title: Deferred Preact documents
sections.body: renderApplication starts root and route loaders concurrently and streams the shell with Suspense fallbacks. Keep optional work as nested promises and consume it with Await. The final snapshot is installed before hydration begins. Top-level loader failures render their route or root boundary; root failures retain root-boundary ownership during hydration.
